claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
Early streaming for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
TV coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Live stream for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is available on CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports app and requires a TV provider login.
Encore for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is at 8 p.m. ET on CBS Sports Network.
Featured Groups coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
Amen Corner coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
Holes 15 & 16 coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is from 11:45 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and Masters.com.
Featured group streaming including Amen Corner for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters on Sunday, April 12 is available on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+.
Golf Monthly notes that the final round of the 2026 Masters can be streamed on services like YouTube TV and DirecTV Stream.
